question: Δ MNO is similar to Δ STU. Perimeter of Δ MNO and Δ STU are 80 cm and 200 cm respectively. If ON = 25 cm, then what is the length of TU?
solution:
GIVEN:

The perimeters of ΔMNO = 80 cm

The perimeter of ΔSTU = 200 cm

Δ MNO is similar to Δ STU, if ON = 25 cm

CONCEPT:

Perimeter of ΔMNO/Perimeter of ΔSTU = ON/UT

CALCULATION:

Perimeter of ΔMNO/Perimeter of ΔSTU = ON/UT

⇒ 80/200 = 25/UT

⇒ UT = 25 × 200/80

⇒ UT = 6 2.5cm

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
